Load Areas data file

load("./euc_crebra_processed_data/euc_crebra_areas_data_cleaned.RData")
euc_crebra_areas_data_for_water_loss <-
  
    euc_crebra_areas_data_cleaned %>%
        
        group_by(organ)   %>% 
        
        mutate(
               # Original image for the stem 101 at 25C lost, replacing stem 
               # value with median from the all stems
               areas_cm2 = replace_na(areas_cm2,  median(areas_cm2, na.rm = TRUE)),
               
               double_sided_areas_cm2 = replace_na(double_sided_areas_cm2,
                                                   median(double_sided_areas_cm2, 
                                                          na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  
        group_by(spcode, tree_id, set_temperature, string_number, vpd_control) %>%  
        
        # Convert cm2 to m2
        mutate(
               # Transform
               areas_m2 = areas_cm2/10000,
               double_sided_areas_m2 = double_sided_areas_cm2/10000,
               leaf_areas_m2 = if_else(organ == "leaves", areas_m2, 0),
               
               ) %>%  

        summarise(areas_m2 = sum(areas_m2),
                  
                  # Sum leaf areas by 0 to get just the leaf areas column
                  leaf_areas_m2 = sum(leaf_areas_m2),
                  
                  double_sided_areas_m2 = sum(double_sided_areas_m2))  %>% 
        
        mutate(set_temperature = as.integer(set_temperature), 
               .keep =  "unused") %>% 
        
        # Reorganize columns
        select(spcode, string_number, tree_id, set_temperature, everything()) %>% 
        arrange(vpd_control) 
glimpse(euc_crebra_areas_data_for_water_loss)

3. Calculate species water loss

Filter data in the 50% to 90% range RWC

euc_crebra_rwc_data_filtered_data <-
    euc_crebra_rwc_data %>%
        filter(relative_water_content_perc <= 0.90 & relative_water_content_perc >= 0.50)

Plot filtered data

Filter data with poor R2

euc_crebra_data_for_water_loss <- 

    euc_crebra_rwc_data_filtered_data  

    # Remove data with poor R2
    # filter(!(vpd_control == "yes" & string_number == "string_8" & set_temperature == 55))
    
    # filter(!(vpd_control == "no" & string_number == "string_8" & set_temperature == 55)) 
save(euc_crebra_data_for_water_loss, 
     file = "./euc_crebra_processed_data/euc_crebra_rwc_filtered_data.RData")

Calculate the water loss rate of change

euc_crebra_slopes <-
    calculate_rate_of_change(euc_crebra_data_for_water_loss)
[1] "Rate of change units: grams * s-1"
[1] "Remember time units must be seconds and weights must be in grams"
# Make sure the maximum row length of the data frame slopes is:
# 8 (individuals)  * 6 (temperatures) + 8 (individuals)  * 7 (temperatures) = 48 + 56 = 104
nrow(euc_crebra_slopes)
[1] 101

Calculate transpiration rates

euc_crebra_transpiration_rates <- 
  calculate_transpiration_rates(droughtbox_data = euc_crebra_data_for_water_loss,
                                leaf_and_branch_area_data = euc_crebra_areas_data_for_water_loss)
[1] "Rate of change units: grams * s-1"
[1] "Remember time units must be seconds and weights must be in grams"

Plot transpiration data

# Add spcode to data before saving 

euc_crebra_water_loss_data <- 
  
  euc_crebra_transpiration_rates %>% 
    
  mutate(spcode = "euc_crebra") %>% 
  select(-c(median_vpd, median_vpd, median_rh, median_temp)) %>% 
  select(spcode, everything())

4. Export data

save(euc_crebra_water_loss_data, 
     file = "./euc_crebra_processed_data/euc_crebra_water_loss_data.RData")
